## Description
Briefly describe the changes introduced by this pull request. What problem does it solve and what are the main changes?

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Code quality / refactoring (PEP8 style alignment, optimization)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist

### Quality & Standards
- [ ] My code follows the code style guidelines of this project (run `black` and `ruff check` on modifications).
- [ ] All new dependencies are explicitly pinned with exact versions in `requirements.txt` and `pyproject.toml`.
- [ ] No secrets or keys are hardcoded in the codebase.

### Testing
- [ ] I have written comprehensive unit or integration tests for my changes.
- [ ] All tests pass locally (`pytest -v`).

### Documentation
- [ ] I have updated the documentation / README.md to reflect these changes (if applicable).
- [ ] No false claims are added to the documentation.

## Verification Details
Describe the steps you took to verify your changes. Include commands run, terminal outputs, or screenshots of the Gradio UI.
